dialogue_history.content: Can you please provide more information on the transfer effectiveness score?

The transfer effectiveness score, or Data Transfer Efficiency (DTE), is calculated as the success percentage divided by the sum of the error tally plus one, rounded to two decimal places. If the error tally plus one equals zero, the DTE is set to null to avoid division by zero.

tool_trajectory.result: The transfer effectiveness score, or Data Transfer Efficiency (DTE), is calculated as the success percentage divided by the sum of the error tally plus one, rounded to two decimal places. If the error tally plus one equals zero, the DTE is set to null to avoid division by zero.

args.sql:
CREATE TABLE metrics AS
SELECT 
    recordregistry,
    ROUND(
        successpct / (
            errtally + 1
        )
    , 2) AS transfer_effectiveness_score
FROM dataflow;
